knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A baseline is recorded so the effect of a change can be compared with the starting point, which is what the lesson requires before deciding to keep or reverse a change. Delay (option 0) and a form requirement (option 2) are not the reasons.

The lesson gives no specific rule for a new starter. Option 1 is the best of the three because it investigates the cause and records the finding, as the review process requires, rather than blaming the product (option 0) or stopping measurement (option 2).
The lesson gives the number of bags of general waste per job as an example of a measure the team can record.

practicalCriteria: Learner selects a small set of measures for product use, water, waste and rework that a team member can record consistently.
Learner records a baseline for a supplied measure over a set period and compares a later result against it.
Learner records one improvement decision with its reason and a check date.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Measure log with baseline, results and review dates
Improvement decision record with reason and check result
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 1 is not done: Choose a small set of measures that the team can record consistently.
